hero_copy.label: Hero introduction
hero_copy.value: I'm Haley Reeder, an instructional designer and learning design and development strategist focused on sales and partner enablement for complex products. I don't just make content; I build and maintain learning experiences from scope and design through delivery, LMS operations, and analytics. I use new tools and approaches when they solve a real problem while grounding the work in proven learning principles.

featured_intro.label: Featured work introduction
featured_intro.value: Browse projects across instructional design, AI evaluation, LMS administration, and workflow automation.

hero_intro_primary.label: Experience summary
hero_intro_primary.value: I started in high-school classrooms and K-12 curriculum, where Universal Design, the Zone of Proximal Development, and problem-posing education shaped how I think about access, challenge, and learner agency. I now design enterprise learning for adult audiences across eLearning, interactive enablement, facilitation, LMS operations, AI quality evaluation, web and coding work, AI chat experiences, and automated workflows.
